## Bug report (verbatim, from the user)
The catalog listing pages look short — with 4 items per page I only ever get 3, and
every page is missing its last item. Worse, some products never show up in the listing
at all. It smells like the pagination slices are off by one somewhere, but the page
numbers themselves look right.

"""Pagination helpers for the catalog listing."""


def paginate(items: list, page: int, per_page: int) -> list:
    """Return the items shown on ``page`` (1-based) with ``per_page`` items per page."""
    if page < 1:
        raise ValueError("page is 1-based")
    if per_page < 1:
        raise ValueError("per_page must be positive")
    start = (page - 1) * per_page
    end = start + per_page - 1
    return items[start:end]


def total_pages(item_count: int, per_page: int) -> int:
    """Number of pages needed for ``item_count`` items."""
    if per_page < 1:
        raise ValueError("per_page must be positive")
    return -(-item_count // per_page)

```

"""Tests for catalog.pagination."""

from catalog.pagination import paginate, total_pages

ITEMS = list(range(10))


def test_first_page_returns_per_page_items():
    assert paginate(ITEMS, 1, 4) == [0, 1, 2, 3]


def test_last_page_returns_remainder():
    assert paginate(ITEMS, 3, 4) == [8, 9]


def test_consecutive_pages_are_contiguous():
    assert paginate(ITEMS, 1, 4) + paginate(ITEMS, 2, 4) == ITEMS[:8]


def test_total_pages_rounds_up():
    assert total_pages(10, 4) == 3

```
